Also many units to unlock by completing some chapters with spesific difficulty and waves on some chapters.
Also, YOU are the troops here and must protect your base until end of the waves.
And one more dimension which make the gameplay much easier.
And you can also become some enemies that fought.

Xtra credits to SuperBroHouse for the designs of ch 4 in general
Credits to bruh man for giving perms to add Uncooked Business
